title: Österreichs Skisport im Nationalsozialismus: Anpassung – Verfolgung – Kollaboration
bookshelves: Category: Sports and Active outdoor recreation
summary: The history of Nazi indoctrination in Austria’s skiing does not begin in March 1938. Even before that, a turn to National Socialism can be traced. Andreas Praher investigates power structures and scope for action in skiing before and during the Nazi era as well as in post-war Austria.
